quote: For the study by Williams et al.86, the focal hypothesis test in the replication is based on a composite score of five suites of behaviour (which are tested separately in the original article) to have a single test.
reason: Blind extracted a null comparison from Study 5 (P = 0.59), whereas Holzmeister et al. selected a statistically significant (P < 0.05) MTurk finding and constructed a composite score across five behavioral suites that were tested separately in the original paper. Because the exact selected condition and composite re-analysis are only in omitted supplementary/OSF materials and the primary paper never reports P < 0.00001 (reporting multiple P < 0.001 effects across studies and conditions), the original p-value cannot be uniquely verified from the supplied texts.
